# Breakout

> Breakout is the classic brick-breaker game for a 2021 Samsung TV (Tizen 6.0, Chromium 76), packaged as a web app (.wgt) that you sideload in developer mode and play with a keyboard or the TV remote.

It is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript: classic script tags on one shared namespace (`window.BO`), no bundler, no framework and no runtime packages. The layout is a fixed 1920x1080, and nothing newer than the TV's Chromium 76 engine is used. Releases are unsigned app folders: you sign and install them with your own Tizen certificate.

## Website

- [English site](https://breakout.cocode.dk/): what the game is and how to install it
- [Persian site](https://breakout.cocode.dk/fa/): the same page in Persian (فارسی)

- [House rules](https://github.com/cocodedk/breakout-tv/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): engine, input and screen rules for contributors and agents
- [Contributing](https://github.com/cocodedk/breakout-tv/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, hooks, branches and the pull request checklist
